description: This Java class defines a Liquibase change for modifying an existing database column, including properties for schema, table, and column configurations. It provides methods to generate the corresponding SQL statement and confirm modification.

classes.name: ModifyColumnChange
classes.description: A class representing a database change for modifying an existing column in a table, including properties for schema, table, and columns, and methods to generate SQL statements and confirmation messages.

methods.name: getCatalogName
methods.description: Returns the name of the catalog, if specified.

methods.name: getSchemaName
methods.description: Returns the schema name, trimmed or null if not set.

methods.name: setSchemaName
methods.description: Sets the schema name, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the table to modify.

methods.name: setTableName
methods.description: Sets the name of the table to modify.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the list of column configurations to modify.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets the list of columns to modify.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a column configuration to the list.

methods.name: removeColumn
methods.description: Removes a specified column configuration from the list.

methods.name: generateStatements
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to perform the column modification.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a confirmation message describing the change.
